programs.title: GRAND SUMO Highlights
programs.desc: . NHK WORLD-JAPAN presents a sumo highlights program for fans around the globe. Today the show features all top-division bouts from November 18, Day 10 of the Grand Sumo Tournament in Fukuoka.

programs.desc: . NHK WORLD-JAPAN broadcasts a variety of programs with 60 titles. This program "Dig More Japan" will extract the essence of these programs and further deepen the charm of Japanese culture.
